interaction: positive training ratings >= 4.0; binary user-item incidence; validation/test labels never enter similarity fit
benchmark_user_selection: first 5000 user IDs in frozen stage-one candidate file, ascending
similarity: exact cosine from sparse X.T @ X; co-occurrence divided by sqrt(item positive-user counts)

lsh.selection: highest target-normalized precision-efficiency score in lsh_grid

evaluation: same frozen stage-one positive test items plus 100 fixed negatives; macro NDCG@10 and Recall@10 over benchmark users with test positives
full_population_note: The Word asks for 191007 users, but exact sparse item-item comparison at full population is not claimed here. This stage reports a deterministic 5000-user exact/LSH benchmark and keeps the full frozen candidate protocol.
